output_list.reason: In the distributeBTR function, the amount of tokens sent to each address is determined by the hardcoded value 2000 * 10**8. The amount of tokens sent is not dynamically determined based on the balance of the contract owner. This means that the contract owner can send more tokens to certain addresses than intended and can also prevent the sending of tokens to other addresses. This vulnerability is exploitable in real world as the contract owner can manipulate the distribution of tokens. Also the contract owner will have to pay for gas to send tokens to the other addresses.
